title: Plant Manager - Brandon, Mississippi
text:
Reliant Processing, LTD is currently hiring for Plant Manager for our Sandhill Liquid Plant located in Brandon, Mississippi.

The candidate will oversee day-to-day operations for the liquid co2 processes.

Duties include but are not limited to:

Strategic planning, setting goals, maintaining budgets, optimizing expenses, enforcing policies and procedures, ensuring employees work productively, improving efficiencies, setting priorities, development of structure, quality control and maintenance.

The basic function of the Plant Manager is to ensure that product quality and availability (liquid) meets the required demand and specifications to be sold to our customers with Safety in the Workplace as the Top Priority on all Functions.

Required: Plant Operations in CO2 Plants. If not in CO2 business, in like gas or processing business.

Preferred: Hands on operating experience for compression and refrigeration equipment. Some experience in AC electrical systems and troubleshooting circuitry. Experience in PLC programming and troubleshooting. Experience in the industrial gas business for handling of carbon dioxide and hazmat rules.

Preferred: Technical training as an Instrument Tech, or Associates in an Engineering related field, 2 year Tech Degree.

Salary: To be determined based upon experience.
